Hero.title:
Back-end Developer
Python & Django
Hero.description: I design, test and ship business applications, secured APIs and automations, with a focus on physical products and traceability.

About.title: About Me
About.description1: A Python/Django developer since March 2024, I work on business software connected to real operations: after-sales service, product traceability, data synchronisation and third-party integrations.
About.description2: At Arcom, I designed and developed an after-sales platform used by about a dozen people. In parallel, I lead the development of Arven Distribution’s internal ERP. My time at 42 Lausanne gave me a solid foundation in C/C++, Unix, networks and systems programming.

Timeline.title: My Journey
Timeline.subtitle: From intensive training to professional practice.
Timeline.bts_title: BTS Systèmes Numériques, option A : Informatique et réseaux
Timeline.bts_desc: Lycée Les Eucalyptus, Nice. French two-year technical degree in computer science and networks (Bac+2 / EQF level 5).
Timeline.piscine_desc: Intensive 4-week selection. Introduction to C, Shell, and fundamental programming concepts.
Timeline.school_desc: Two-year programme in C/C++, Unix, networks, algorithms and Docker. Projects: Minishell, Webserv and Inception.
Timeline.arcom_desc: Designed and developed the production after-sales platform: Django, PostgreSQL, Redis, secured APIs and SOAP/SFTP/n8n integrations. Nightly import of more than five years of sales, around 620 tests and GitHub Actions CI. Offline barcode-scanning PWA in testing. Part-time during 42, then full-time.
Timeline.arven_desc: Designed and led an internal ERP currently in development. OIDC with two-factor authentication, role-based permissions and an audit log. Around 1,350 tests and 99.97% back-end coverage. Amazon SP-API integration in progress.

Projects.title: Projects
Projects.subtitle: Business applications, integrations and systems programming. Professional codebases remain private; each project states its context and development status.
Projects.arcom_desc: Production after-sales platform; offline scanning PWA in testing. Private codebase. Django, PostgreSQL and Redis.
Projects.portfolio_desc: This personal site: Next.js 16, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS and Framer Motion. French/English, light and dark themes, localised metadata and deployment on Vercel.
Projects.minishell_desc: 42 Lausanne project in C: a Unix shell reimplementation with pipelines, redirections, builtins, environment variables and signal handling.
Projects.cub3d_desc: 3D rendering engine style Wolfenstein 3D created from scratch in C. Physics management, textures, and raycasting.
Projects.philosophers_desc: Simulation of the dining philosophers problem. Complex management of concurrency, threads, mutexes, and deadlock prevention.
Projects.arven_desc: Internal ERP in development, private codebase. Python/Django/DRF, PostgreSQL and Celery; Amazon SP-API integration in progress.
